status: Follow-up after observing seed99 zero-RMSE increase of the globally applied frozen blends; exploratory, not preregistered before the first experiment
candidate: Use the already frozen 50:50 strict_balance prediction only when baseline predicted SFR>10; otherwise keep baseline prediction exactly
rationale: Protect low-SFR predictions, using the existing tail-training boundary10 as a fixed inference routing threshold
no_target_routing: The routing decision uses predicted SFR only, not actual SFR or validation class labels
evaluation: Reuse the same seed42/7/99 OOF arrays. No threshold grid or fraction retuning. This is descriptive repeated-CV evidence, not independent confirmation of the new routing rule.
acceptance: Extreme RMSE must decrease, overall mean-fold RMSE ratio<=1.001, zero pooled RMSE ratio<=1.0 in each seed. Preserve and report the failure of the initial global-blend strict-zero acceptance rule separately.
artifacts: Save protected_model only if acceptance passes on all seeds; otherwise report results without replacing original recommended_model or current_model.json
